review_candidates.description: Company Description Wollo University CMHS Anesthesia Department is part of the College of Medicine and Health Sciences, dedicated to delivering safe, evidence-based perioperative and critical care services. The department supports surgical and medical teams through comprehensive anesthesia care for a wide range of procedures. It focuses on training future anesthesia professionals, promoting clinical excellence, and engaging in academic activities. Team members work in a collaborative environment that values ethical practice, continuous learning, and patient-centered care. Role Description The Anesthetist will provide anesthesia care for patients undergoing surgical and diagnostic procedures in an on-site, hospital-based setting in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Day-to-day responsibilities include preoperative assessment, planning appropriate anesthesia techniques, administering general and regional anesthesia, and monitoring patients during and after procedures. The role involves participating in critical care management, supporting postoperative pain control, and responding to anesthesia-related emergencies. The Anesthetist will collaborate closely with surgeons, physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure safe, high-quality patient outcomes and may contribute to teaching and mentoring within the department. This is a full-time, on-site position. Qualifications Strong foundation in anesthesiology and medicine, with the ability to apply clinical knowledge to diverse patient populations. Competence in general anesthesia and related techniques for a variety of surgical and procedural settings. Experience or training in critical care medicine, including perioperative monitoring and management of unstable patients. Ability to work effectively within surgical teams and support safe surgical care across multiple specialties. Recognized medical degree and formal training in anesthesia; relevant certification or licensure as required by national regulations. Demonstrated commitment to patient safety, ethical clinical practice, and adherence to institutional and national clinical guidelines. Effective communication, teamwork, and documentation skills, with the ability to work in a high-demand clinical environment. Interest in teaching, continued professional development, and participation in departmental academic or quality improvement activities.

review_candidates.description: Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined. (NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year —if you're a better fit for another role, we'll route your application accordingly and if we're not quite ready for you, we'll reach back out later.) At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That's why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers , don't just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don't just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers. As an Administrative Operations Specialist , you will be an essential partner to an Oceans client, managing their professional life and helping them stay organized, on track, and focused on high-priority goals. You'll handle their work-related calendars, correspondence, and administrative tasks, all while ensuring seamless communication across various internal and external teams. This role requires exceptional organization, the ability to anticipate needs, and the ability to communicate effectively. You'll play an important role in streamlining operations and helping your client achieve success without taking on management responsibilities or representing them in meetings. Accountability Your success as an Administrative Operations Specialist will be measured by your ability to keep your client's professional life running smoothly, allowing them to focus on their highest-value tasks . Here's how you'll make an impact: Work Calendar & Scheduling Management Manage and optimize your client's work calendar, scheduling meetings, appointments, and events based on business priorities Coordinate meetings with internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders, ensuring efficient use of their time Organize and prioritize daily tasks, meetings, and follow-ups to ensure deadlines are met Handle business travel arrangements based on the client's work schedule and specific needs Correspondence & Communication Serve as the point of contact for your client's emails, phone calls, and other professional communication, ensuring responses are timely and professional Manage and streamline the flow of information to ensure your client receives all the relevant updates and data they need Prepare and organize materials for meetings, including agendas, presentations, and reports Employee & Client Relations Act as a liaison between your client and their internal teams, ensuring smooth communication and follow-through on tasks and initiatives Help manage positive and productive relationships with key stakeholders Provide logistical support for client-facing meetings, including coordination of schedules, follow-ups, and additional requirements Task & Project Coordination Coordinate small-scale projects and tasks that align with your client's strategic goals, tracking progress and ensuring all milestones are achieved Research and compile information as needed for ongoing tasks or initiatives Assist with ensuring deadlines are met, proactively following up on open tasks Colleagues Your primary stakeholder will be the Executive you support, working alongside their internal teams and external stakeholders. You'll help manage the flow of information and keep the work environment organized, enabling your client to focus on the strategic aspects of their role. At Oceans, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career. Skills And Qualifications At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As an Administrative Operations Specialist, your vertical focus will be on professional administration, ensuring smooth operations through efficient scheduling, communication, and task management. Your horizontal focus will span organizational efficiency, stakeholder management, and proactive problem-solving, enabling you to adapt to different demands and support your client effectively. To excel in this role, you should have: Language Skills: Professional fluency in English, with excellent reading, writing, and speaking abilities Experience: At least 5 years in a communication-heavy role at a reputable firm, demonstrating strong interpersonal and organizational skills Education: An undergraduate degree is preferred, though relevant work experience is also valued. Certifications such as an MBA, CFA, CIM, CIPM, or CIMA will be considered as an added advantage Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported. During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas: Empathy: How comfortable are you with putting yourself in the shoes of the other person and anticipating needs? Time Management & Adaptability: How do you handle multiple tasks and shifting deadlines while staying organized? Communication: Can you manage professional communication and correspondence while maintaining professionalism and clarity? Stakeholder Coordination: How do you effectively work with teams and external parties to ensure everything runs smoothly while balancing multiple priorities? Attention to Detail: How do you ensure accuracy in meeting preparation and follow-ups? Taking Initiative and Ownership: How do you go above and beyond your given tasks to add value and drive efficiency? Problem-Solving: How do you handle scheduling conflicts and other administrative challenges? Tech Proficiency: What digital tools or software have you used to streamline tasks and improve workflows? Role Specifications This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client's time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we'll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors. About Oceans At Oceans Talent, we connect the world's top talent with visionary companies building what's next. Here, you're not just stepping into another role — you're joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you. We're always excited to share more about our journey, where we're headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process. review_candidates.description: Support utilisateurs IT / Helpdesk - Client final - H/F Accompagner les utilisateurs d’un groupe international dans leur usage quotidien des applications métier. Support fonctionnel, qualification des incidents, résolution de premier niveau et coordination avec les équipes informatiques. 🎣 Vous avez déjà travaillé en support utilisateurs et vous aimez comprendre un problème avant de le transmettre ? Au sein de la DSI d’un groupe international, vous rejoignez l’équipe en charge du support des utilisateurs sur les applications métier et vous êtes leur premier point de contact. Vous analysez leurs demandes, résolvez les sujets relevant du premier niveau et orientez les problématiques plus complexes vers le bon interlocuteur. Ce poste peut vous intéresser si vous aimez chercher, analyser, expliquer et assurer le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur traitement. 🌍 Le contexte de ce groupe international (secteur Industrie) : Vous rejoignez la DSI d’un groupe international dont les applications accompagnent directement l’activité opérationnelle. Les demandes concernent principalement l’utilisation des applications métier et les processus auxquels elles sont liées. Sage X3 fait partie de cet environnement applicatif. Sa connaissance constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable : les processus internes étant spécifiques, une formation aux outils et au métier est prévue. 🤝 Le cadre humain et l’équipe Vous rejoignez une DSI à taille humaine, organisée autour de plusieurs expertises : développement, support et gestion de projets applicatifs. Vous travaillez en lien direct avec les utilisateurs, les référents métiers, l’équipe informatique et les responsables applicatifs. Vous pouvez vous appuyer sur des interlocuteurs expérimentés lorsque le sujet dépasse votre niveau d’intervention. Des points d’équipe réguliers permettent de partager les situations en cours, d’alerter sur les difficultés rencontrées et de débloquer rapidement certains sujets. La dimension relationnelle est importante : le poste demande de savoir écouter, reformuler, expliquer et adapter son discours à des interlocuteurs différents. 💡 Ce que ce poste vous apporte concrètement Rejoindre une DSI interne et accompagner les utilisateurs dans la durée. Être au contact direct des utilisateurs et mesurer concrètement l’impact de votre accompagnement. Développer progressivement votre connaissance des flux métier et de l’environnement applicatif. Travailler avec différentes expertises : support, exploitation, développement et projets. 🧭 Vos missions Votre rôle consiste à prendre en charge les demandes utilisateurs depuis leur réception jusqu’à leur résolution ou leur orientation vers le bon interlocuteur. Réceptionner, analyser et qualifier les demandes et incidents utilisateurs. Résoudre les demandes relevant du support de premier niveau. Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’utilisation des applications. Orienter les sujets nécessitant une expertise complémentaire vers le bon interlocuteur en apportant les éléments de contexte nécessaires. Assurer le suivi et la traçabilité des demandes dans l’outil de gestion des tickets. Participer à la gestion de certains droits et habilitations utilisateurs. Contribuer à la documentation et, ponctuellement, aux formations utilisateurs. 👤 Votre parcours Vous justifiez d’ au moins 3 ans d’expérience en support utilisateurs ou support applicatif, alternance comprise . Une expérience sur un ERP ou sur des applications intégrées à des processus métier est particulièrement appréciée. Une connaissance de Sage X3 constitue un plus, notamment sur les périmètres achats ou négoce, ou dans la gestion des droits utilisateurs, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Au-delà des outils, nous recherchons surtout : Un réel sens du service utilisateurs De la curiosité et une bonne capacité d’analyse De la rigueur dans le suivi des demandes Une aisance relationnelle et le goût du travail en équipe. 🌍 Langues Un très bon niveau d’anglais, notamment à l’oral, est indispensable . Notre force : la qualité de notre recherche alliée à notre investissement sans faille et à notre réactivité Notre atout : une parfaite connaissance de la communauté IT/FINANCE et un important réseau actif Notre distinction : une approche et un accompagnement personnalisés, à l’écoute des projets et des ambitions des candidats et de nos clients. review_candidates.title: Sales Executive
review_candidates.description: Company Description Fort Steel is a leading Egyptian company specializing in steel and building materials supplies for contractors, developers, and major construction projects nationwide. The company is built on reliability, transparency, and deep industry experience, ensuring consistent quality and efficient service. With direct access to local production sources, Fort Steel offers guaranteed availability, competitive pricing, and premium-grade steel for both small and large developments. A strong supply chain allows timely delivery across all project stages, supporting clients from planning to completion. Guided by a mission to provide world-class products and professional services, Fort Steel continues to grow as a trusted partner in Egypt’s construction and development sectors. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Sales Executive role based in Cairo, Egypt. The Sales Executive will identify and develop new business opportunities with contractors, developers, and project owners, while maintaining strong relationships with existing clients. Daily responsibilities include prospecting, making client visits, preparing and presenting quotations, negotiating prices and terms, and following up to close deals. The role also involves coordinating with supply chain and operations teams to ensure accurate order processing, timely delivery, and customer satisfaction. The Sales Executive will monitor market trends, gather competitor insights, and prepare regular sales reports to support strategic planning and revenue growth. Qualifications Proven skills in B2B sales, client relationship management, and account development within industrial or construction sectors. Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-makers and close deals. Ability to conduct basic market research, analyze customer needs, and prepare accurate quotations and sales proposals. Solid organizational and time-management skills, including managing pipelines, follow-ups, and sales reporting. Familiarity with steel or building materials, construction project workflows, and supply chain coordination is highly beneficial. Comfort with using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and basic office software to track leads and prepare documentation. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Fluency in Arabic and good command of English, with the ability to communicate professionally with diverse stakeholders. Willingness to work on-site, visit client locations, and adapt to a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
